hook_line: PEPSICO TO CUT ABOUT 1,000 NORTH AMERICA JOBS

hook_stat.sub: Jobs to be eliminated across North American food and beverage operations

stats.label: Fall in North American beverage volumes last quarter
Full-year core EPS growth outlook, cut by management

diaspora_bullets: North America CEO Ram Krishnan told staff the structure was complex and fragmented
The cuts are due over the coming week across the food and drinks businesses
news_summary: PepsiCo is eliminating about 1,000 jobs across its North American food and beverage operations over the coming week, in a restructuring North America CEO Ram Krishnan announced to staff on November 9.
payoff: No specific savings target for the 1,000 positions has been disclosed.
